provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: exhaustion over all 64620 pairs of 2-qutrit stabilizer states

notes: Pairs with the lean-certified rank-3 decomposition to settle this cell at chi = 3 exactly, and closes it as a route to the published exponent, which would need rank 2 here. The exclusion rests on a margin rather than exact arithmetic: the closest any two candidate directions come to parallel is 0.71 (N) or 0.73 (H3) against a threshold of 1 - 1e-6, so no rounding at the 1e-15 level of these inputs can close the gap. The same search finds the known rank-2 decomposition of the Strange state at m=2, which the certificate runs as a positive control and fails without.
